section_summary.extract_value: The figure presents four mediation models (a-d) examining attitudes and orientations as mediators in the relationship between body-related talk (exercise talk and weight-loss/diet talk) and body appreciation. The models display path coefficients showing direct and indirect relationships between variables including Performance, Appearance, and Body Appreciation. No specific study numbers or sample subsets are explicitly identified in the provided text.

Asset Caption.extract_value: Figure 1. Attitudes and orientations as mediators in the relationship between body-related talk and body appreciation. (a) Attitudes as mediators for exercise talk and body appreciation, F(3, 138) = 53.66, p < .001, r² = .54. (b) Orientations as mediators for exercise talk and body appreciation, F(3, 137) = 14.40, p < .001, r² = .24. (c) Attitudes as mediators for weight-loss talk and body appreciation, F(3, 138) = 62.14, p < .001, r² = .57. (d) Orientations as mediators for weight-loss talk and body appreciation, F(3, 137) = 22.23, p < .001, r² = .33.
